key_insight: Weld strength in FFF-printed thermoplastics depends on coupled processing, material, and printed-structure effects, not simply higher welding energy.
engineering_relevance: Welding can enable assemblies larger than a printer’s build volume, provided joint design accounts for infill, porosity, and interlayer bonding.
method: Critically review six welding techniques for FFF-printed thermoplastics.
Compare joining mechanisms, process parameters, and material characteristics.
Relate joint structure and defects to mechanical performance and failure.
evidence_signal: The reviewed evidence links joint quality to interacting process and structural factors, but differing materials, geometries, and tests limit direct technique comparisons.
watch_item: Evidence for microwave-assisted welding of separately printed components remains limited.
paper_title: Welding of thermoplastics printed by fused filament fabrication: A critical review of joining mechanisms and relationships between processing, structure, and properties
